title: Long-Standing Member Point Value on Redemption — Kessler Owner Rewards, Service Accounts and Repair Orders
content:
**Point value schedule — Service Accounts and Repair Orders.** The value of a redeemed point follows the tier and how long the account has been open.

| Account tier | Whole months from the opening date to the redemption date | Credited per point (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 60 or more | 0.0125 |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 60 or more | 0.011 |
| Any account, fewer than 60 whole months, or any other tier | — | the tier's point value |

The redemption date is the day the redemption is made. A whole month is complete on the same day of a later month, or on the first day of the month after it where that month has no such day.

**Edges (hypothetical dates).** Account opened 5 January: 60 whole months on 5 January five years later; 59 on 4 January that year.

**Applied (hypothetical).** 4200 redeemable points on a Platinum account open 64 whole months are worth 52.50; on a Silver account open as long, 46.20.
